card.name: Antidepressant suicidality monitoring warning wording
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "for" or "until" right after "monitor" or "antidepressant-treated patients" in the suicidality boxed warning. It also fires on a comma in a list of goals in a quoted speech.

modes.label: Monitor for worsening
modes.description: The word "for" after a monitoring phrase in the antidepressant suicidality warning, just before clinical worsening.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that continue a change or a challenge, and away from words meaning about or approximately.
card.plain: It marks the small word in the antidepressant warning that tells you to watch patients for worsening.
